demos.name: AgentCore PingOne LAB
demos.description: An AI agent on AWS Bedrock AgentCore Runtime whose identity comes from PingOne, in mock only: the M2M flow (the agent's own token), the USER_FEDERATION 3LO flow (a human login through the agent, four measured shapes), and on-behalf-of delegation. Mock/Real toggle; Real ships disabled.
demos.notes: Docker: HOST_PORT=7601 docker compose up --build -d (published on 127.0.0.1 only). Mock engine only: no tenant, no credentials, netguard blocks all outbound; Real mode is offered but 409s with a how-to until the owner wires a live engine. Catalog id D114 (assigned by the owner 2026-11-04). The M2M shape and the four 3LO shapes are measured on the owner's verified build; the step order and codes are the lab's own model.
